notes: triage and refunds hand off to each other by name inside a Swarm (the Swarm adds no edge of its own); triage's Handoff(target='user') returns control to the user and names no agent, so it is unresolved. The RoundRobinGroupChat bound to review is a manager over writer and critic. In the 0.2 file the GroupChatManager named lead runs the coder/tester group chat.
uncertainty: agents lists what the AutoGen inventory parser reports: it names agents by constructor (AssistantAgent), not by their name argument (triage, refunds, writer, critic, coder, tester), and both files collapse to one entry. Through v2.16.0 the parser was not registered in scanner discovery, so scans reported no AutoGen agent and this list was empty. The delegation graph, which names the agents, is the subject of this case
